messages.text: What is measurement method, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

### Short answer
Measurement method is the specific way a test quantity is measured and evaluated, such as RSE by TRP, EIRP coarse-grid screening followed by TRP fine-grid measurement, or the substitution reference method where the DUT is replaced by a calibrated antenna and signal generator and EIRP is calculated from antenna gain and cable loss [5][6][29].  
Product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding the method include whether to configure for EIRP or TRP evaluation, whether to use early-exit EIRP screening before TRP, which grid/procedure to use, which chamber/scan geometry to support, which detector bandwidth/integration approach to use, and which R&S system/software/options fit the required workflow [1][3][5][6][8][33].  
### Measurement method examples supported by the passages
- For FCC / ANSI C63.26 5G FR2 RSE, the stated method is TRP, with EIRP early-exit criteria and TRP only for failing frequencies [6].  
- For RSE measurement including substitution, the reference method is substitution: the DUT is replaced by a calibrated antenna with signal generator, the generator level is tuned to the same receive value as the DUT, and EIRP is calculated by adding antenna gain and cable loss [29].  
- TRP procedure selection depends on available test setup, measurement equipment, and measurement time [8].  
### Product-related decisions that depend on it
| Decision | Why measurement method matters | Supported product / option facts |
|---|---|---|
| Choose EIRP vs TRP evaluation | R&S ELEKTRA supports 3D EIRP evaluation by measuring EIRP instead of field strength, while 5G FR2 RSE requirements are often expressed with TRP and may use EIRP as a screening step before TRP [1][11]. | ELEKTRA option ELEMI-3D supports 3D EIRP evaluation, SAC/FAR 3D measurement, elevation positioner, spherical elevation or cylindrical height scan, and 3D result presentation [1]. |
| Decide whether early-exit screening is acceptable | FCC / ANSI C63.26 is described as using EIRP early-exit criteria, with TRP only for failing frequencies [6]. | ELEKTRA’s 5G FR2 workflow includes overview measurement, data reduction, maximization, adjustment, and final measurement [33]. |
| Select grid density and TRP procedure | The two-step RSE method uses coarse and fine grids, and the listed grid points differ by coarse/fine and constant-density/constant-step-size approaches [5]. | ELEKTRA’s final measurement can calculate 2-cut TRP and 3-cut TRP, and full TRP is performed if the limit is exceeded [33]. |
| Select chamber and scan geometry | R&S ELEKTRA supports SAC and FAR 3D measurement, elevation positioner, spherical elevation scan, and cylindrical height scan [1]. | TS8996 basic RSE setup can use FAR with azimuth and optional elevation scan, or SAC with height scan [39]. |
| Choose detector bandwidth / integration | ELEKTRA supports virtual RMS detectors with 100 MHz and 200 MHz bandwidth by integrating lower-bandwidth measurements over a sliding window [3]. | This is used for parallel measurement of -13 dBm/MHz and -10 dBm/100 MHz limits [3]. |
| Choose R&S system scope for FR2 RSE | For FR2, 3GPP validated tests with ATS1800C are mapped to TS8980, while ETSI / FCC broader RSE requirements are mapped to TS8996 [37]. | TS8996 is described as supporting 5G FR2 RSE extensions up to 220 GHz / 325 GHz in an anechoic chamber [37]. |
| Decide whether substitution capability is needed | RSE reference method is substitution, and ELEKTRA supports it [29]. | In the substitution method, the DUT is replaced by a calibrated antenna with signal generator and EIRP is calculated from antenna gain and cable loss [29]. |

passages.text:
R&S ELEKTRA › 3D EIRP Evaluation / ELEMI-3D
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- 量測 [[EIRP]]（Effective Isotropic Radiated Power）instead of field strength。
- 支援 SAC and FAR 3D measurement。
- 支援 elevation positioner。
- 支援 spherical elevation 或 cylindrical height scan。
- 支援 3D result presentation。
- option 名稱為 [[ELEMI-3D]]。

R&S ELEKTRA
[[R&S ELEKTRA]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 EMC / RSE test automation software；[[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]] 只把它列為 [[R&S TS8996]] RSE & customization 的 solution mapping，[[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]（07/2025）則描述它在 [[Radiated Spurious Emissions]]、[[5G FR2 RSE 測試]]、wireless EMC / EMS 與報告管理中的具體功能。

R&S ELEKTRA › 5G FR2 test procedure support
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- ELEKTRA is next generation EMC test SW。
- For 5G support of RSE measurement procedures with extension for 5G FR2。
- 支援 3D and TRP evaluation。
- 支援 5G signaling with [[R&S CMX500]]。
- Mixers and calibration procedure also supported by EMC32。
- EMI test sequence adopted to support RSE requirements。
- Sweeps 可 free run（for FDD）或 gated sweep（triggered by CMX, for TDD）。
- 支援 elevation positioner。
- 支援 3D view possibility for overview measurement, maximization and final TRP measurement。
- Typical test distance: **1 m for >40 GHz** and **3 m for <40 GHz**。
- Workflow steps 包含 overview measurement、data reduction、maximization、adjustment、final measurement。
- Virtual RMS detectors with **100 MHz and 200 MHz bandwidth** 可把 lower bandwidth measurement integration over 100 MHz / 200 MHz sliding window，用於平行量測 -13 dBm/MHz 與 -10 dBm/100 MHz limits。

5G FR2 RSE 測試 › 使用限制
- 本頁主要依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]] 這份 2025/07 Market 簡報整理，不是 standards text。
- ETSI 301 908-25 來源仍標示 draft；需回查正式 ETSI 文件與 harmonized standard status。
- FCC / ANSI C63.26 / KDB 842590 的公式、frequency range、early exit criteria 與 test distance 需回正式文件確認。
- TS8980 / TS8996 分工是 R&S solution positioning，不等同第三方 certification scope。
- `-13 dBm`、`-13 dBm/MHz`、`-10 dBm/100 MHz` 在來源不同 slide 使用，引用時需保留 slide context，不可混用。

5G FR2 RSE 測試 › EIRP / TRP two-step method
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- 先用 [[EIRP]] coarse grid identify spurious emission frequencies。
- EIRP limit is valid as long as max. EIRP is below TRP limit。
- 對 EIRP above the limit 的 frequencies，用 fine grid 執行 [[TRP]]。
- Grid selection for spurious emissions is up to test system implementation，但需 meet criteria。
- 來源列出的 grid points：coarse constant density 35；coarse constant step size 62（30°）；fine constant density 135；fine constant step size 266（15°）。

5G FR2 RSE 測試 › FCC / ANSI C63.26 口徑
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- ANSI C63.26 RSE frequency ranges：
  - RF signal <10 GHz: 10th harmonic, max. 40 GHz。
  - RF signal <30 GHz: 5th harmonic, max. 100 GHz。
  - RF signal >30 GHz: 5th harmonic, max. 200 GHz。
- FCC 47 CFR Part 30, KDB 842590 and ANSI C63.26：
  - 30 MHz up to 5th harmonic / 100 GHz（devices <30 GHz）或 200 GHz（devices >30 GHz）。
  - Limit -13 dBm。
  - Method: TRP。
  - Early exit criteria for EIRP, TRP only for failing frequencies。
  - Test distance formula 在來源中 OCR 為 `≥ 2D2/`，公式不完整，需回查原文。
- 來源稱 FCC requires 30 MHz to 5th harmonic / 200 GHz and semi anechoic chamber → [[R&S TS8996]]。

⚠️ [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]（07/2025）說 FCC 5G FR2 RSE requirement starts at 30 MHz up to 5th harmonic / 100 GHz or 200 GHz，但既有頁面 [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]] 說 5G NR FR2 FCC analyzer frequency range 是 9 kHz–200 GHz。判斷：兩者可能分別是 test requirement lower bound 與 analyzer / general spectrum investigation range 口徑；未回查 47 CFR、KDB 842590 與 ANSI C63.26 前並列保留。

TRP › 使用限制
- 本頁只保存 GFM324 對 TRP 的 OTA BS transmitter testing 語境，不是 antenna measurement 標準全文。
- 不可由本頁推論任一產品、基地台或天線的 TRP 規格。
- TRP procedure、grid density、uncertainty budget 與 applicability 需回查 [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]]、[[3GPP TR 37.941]] 與 R&S application note 原文。

TRP › TRP measurement procedures
來源列出多種 TRP procedures：

1. Full sphere using reference steps（accurate）。
2. Full sphere using sparse sampling（overestimate）。
3. Two cuts + Pattern multiplication（accurate）；Pattern multiplication 是 conditional。
4. Two/three cuts（overestimate）。
5. Beam-based directions。
6. Peak method。
7. Equal sector with peak average。
8. Pre-scan。

來源指出 procedure 選擇取決於 available test setup、measurement equipment 與 measurement time。

TRP › 來源定義
依 [[GFM324_1e_5G_NR_BaseStation_OTA_TX_Tests]]（06.2020）：

- TRP 或 radiated power 是 base station 輻射出的 total power。
- TRP 定義為 antenna 周圍 whole sphere 上每個角度的 radiation intensity，以 watts per steradian I(θ,φ) 積分。
- Antenna radiated power（Prad）也稱為 total radiated power（PTRP）。
- 來源公式：PTRP = ∫φ=0..2π ∫θ=0..π I(θ,φ) · sinθ dθ dφ。
- Far field 中，radiation intensity 定義為 I(θ,φ) = EIRP(θ,φ) / 4π。
- 來源亦寫成：PTRP = 1/4π ∫φ=0..2π ∫θ=0..π EIRP(θ,φ) · sinθ dθ dφ。
- 來源說這些公式雖在 far-field conditions 下推導，但依 energy conservation principle，在較近距離也有效。

Radiated Spurious Emissions › 使用限制
- 本頁不是任何標準的正式定義。
- RSE limits、frequency range、detector、RBW / VBW、test distance、antenna、grid 與 pass / fail criteria 必須依具體標準與產品類別判定。
- 本頁目前主要是 R&S solution / Market 簡報抽取，不可替代 [[FCC]]、[[ETSI]]、[[3GPP]]、[[ANSI C63.26]] 或 [[ERC Recommendation 74-01]] 原文。

Radiated Spurious Emissions › RSE 與 EIRP / TRP
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- [[R&S ELEKTRA]] 支援 3D [[EIRP]] evaluation：量測 Effective Isotropic Radiated Power instead of field strength。
- 5G FR2 來源多以 [[TRP]] method 表示 test requirement。
- ETSI 301 908-25 draft 來源描述 two-step method：先用 EIRP coarse grid 找 spurious frequencies，再對 EIRP above limit 的 frequencies 執行 TRP fine grid。
- Final measurement 可計算 2-cut TRP、3-cut TRP；若 limit exceeded，另執行 full TRP。

Radiated Spurious Emissions
[[Radiated Spurious Emissions]]（RSE）是無線裝置在載波與必要頻寬之外，以輻射方式發出的 unwanted emissions 測試項目；本 vault 目前主要由 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]] 與 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]] 支撐。

FR2 OTA spatial test metrics › 使用限制
- 本頁主要依 [[TS8980_RF_Conf_FR2_Customer_Presentation_Status_2020_11_02]] Slide 10 整理，該來源是 2020-11-02 customer presentation 的 lossy derivative，不是 3GPP 標準全文。
- Slide 10 中部分 test case numbering / labels 可能受 OCR 影響，例如 TX Spurious Emissions 與 6.5.3.1 的排列需回查原始投影片。
- 本頁只保存 metric taxonomy 與來源語句，不提供測試限值、grid definition、uncertainty、measurement bandwidth、beam management procedure 或 pass/fail criteria。
- [[EIRP]]、[[TRP]] 與 [[EIS]] 的正式定義與測試程序需回查對應 3GPP、R&S application note 或 chamber / test system 文件。

FR2 OTA spatial test metrics › TRP @ Beam Peak metric
來源文字：

- TRP metric – two antennas required, link + measurement。
- Lock the beam in best TX beam。
- Measure power per grid point。
- Calculate average。

判斷：本來源將 [[TRP]] @ beam peak 描述為固定最佳 TX beam 後，在 sphere grid 上量測 power 並平均；此處是 FR2 UE conformance presentation 的簡化說明，正式 grid / uncertainty / integration method 仍需回查 3GPP 或 application note。

FR2 OTA spatial test metrics › EIRP @ Beam Peak / TX Beam Peak metric
來源文字：

- EIRP metric：In best TX beam peak direction measure power。
- TX Beam peak metric：Same as EIRP but non-power measurement, e.g. EVM。
- For chapter 6 the beam peak is Tx beam peak = 100%-tile of EIRP CDF = strongest beam。

因此在此來源中：

- Power measurement at strongest TX beam 可用 [[EIRP]] @ beam peak。
- 非 power measurement，例如 [[EVM]]，也可使用 TX beam peak direction 作為量測方向。

5G NR OTA Base Station Transmitter Tests › Calibration 與量測方法
來源指出 OTA system 必須在測試前校準，並使用：

- SMW-K544。
- FSW-K544。

校準目標是納入 cable losses、antenna losses、OTA losses 等 system loss。流程包括 sweep CW signal、measure received power、create attenuation table、apply attenuation table and reference antenna gain table to K544。

- [[R&S TS8996]]：RSE test system，本來源補足 basic setup、frequency ranges、signal conditioning、FR2 extension、TS8980 differentiation 與 up to 325 GHz 的 system extension。
- [[R&S ELEKTRA]]：EMC / RSE automation software，本來源列出 RSE features、UI / EUT management、3D EIRP、OOB burst analysis、signaling 與 options。
- [[R&S TS8997]]：來源稱 TS8996 可與 regulatory tests（TS8997）combination；仍未提供 TS8997 full name 或規格。
- [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]]：來源在 TS8980 / TS8996 differentiation 中列為 FR1 additional radiated EMC tests；另在 wireless EMS slides 中出現 EMS test system context。
- [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：來源將其與 TS8996 區分，FR2 3GPP validated CATR 測試屬 TS8980，ETSI / FCC broader RSE 屬 TS8996。
- [[R&S CMX500]]：來源作為 signaling / trigger / 5G support 相關儀器，支援 CMW / CMX integrated support for 2G/3G/4G/5G/WLAN/BT。
- [[Radiated Spurious Emissions]]：本來源核心測試項目。
- [[5G FR2 RSE 測試]]：本來源最密集的技術 / 法規內容，涵蓋 3GPP、FCC、ETSI、EIRP、TRP、test distance、angular step、signal conditioning 與 ELEKTRA workflow。
- [[EIRP]]、[[TRP]]、[[Substitution method]]、[[Virtual RMS detector]]、[[Anechoic chamber]]、[[SAC]]、[[FAR]]：來源中的 RSE 測試方法與場地語彙。

RSE Test System TS8996 (1) › 與既有知識的關係
- 補強既有 [[R&S TS8996]]：先前頁面只來自 wireless regulatory test 簡報中的 solution mapping；本來源提供 TS8996 專屬簡報，增加基本架構、sensitivity、signal conditioning modules、ELEKTRA options、FR2 extension 與 up to 325 GHz 擴充資訊。
- 補強既有 [[R&S ELEKTRA]]：先前只知道 ELEKTRA 與 TS8996 RSE & customization 同列；本來源提供 ELEKTRA UI、automation、EUT management、3D EIRP、OOB burst analysis、multi-band measurement 與 RSE option list。
- 補強既有 [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]]：本來源提供 FCC / ANSI C63.26 對 5G FR2 RSE 頻率上限與 30 MHz lower start 的簡報說法，但與既有頁面中的 `9 kHz – 200 GHz` analyzer / regulatory range 口徑不同，需要並列保存。
- 補強既有 [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]：本來源列出 ETSI 301 908-25 draft、ERC Recommendation 74-01 與 FR2 UE RSE TRP limits，並支援 5G FR2 RSE 概念頁。
- 補強既有 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：本來源清楚區分 TS8980 3GPP validated tests 與 TS8996 ETSI / FCC RSE requirements，但未提供 TS8980 formal specifications 或 validation matrix。

FCC 無線設備法規測試 › 來源中的法規架構
依 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]]，FCC compliance requirements are defined in [[47 CFR]]，並由 C63 standards and KDBs 提供 additional guidance。

來源將無線技術分為：

| 類別 | 來源列出的規則 / guidance |
|---|---|
| Cellular in licensed bands | 47CFR §2 / §22 / §24 / §27 / … |
| Satellite / NTN in licensed bands | [[47 CFR §25]] Satellite Communications |
| Wi-Fi & Co. in unlicensed bands | [[47 CFR §15]] C / E；2.4 GHz ISM band §15.247 & [[KDB558074]]；5 GHz U-NII bands §15.407 / .247 & [[KDB789033]] / [[KDB905462]] DFS；6 GHz U-NII(5-8) §15.407 & [[KDB987594]] |
| Ultra Wideband | [[47 CFR §15F]] Ultra-Wideband Operation |

來源另列：

- [[ANSI C63.26]]：Compliance Testing of Transmitters Used in the Licensed Radio Service。
- [[ANSI C63.10]]：Compliance Testing of Unlicensed Wireless Devices。
- [[IEEE Std 1528-2013]]：SAR measurement techniques。
- [[C63.19]]：Hearing Aid Compatibility。

passages.text:
EIRP › 使用限制
- 本頁只保存 GFM324 對 EIRP 的測試語境定義，不是天線理論或法規標準全文。
- 不可由本頁推論任一產品、基地台或天線的 EIRP 規格。
- EIRP limits、measurement uncertainty、antenna gain table 與 calibration method 需回查對應 3GPP / R&S 文件。

EIRP › 在 GFM324 測試中的用途
來源明示使用 EIRP measurement 的 test cases：

- [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]] 6.2 Radiated transmit power。
- [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]] 6.5.1 OTA transmitter OFF power（EIRP in beam peak）。
- [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]] 6.5.2 OTA transmitter transient period。

在 6.2 Radiated transmit power 測試中，來源說 radiated transmit power 定義為 declared beam 在特定 beam peak direction 的 EIRP level，且每個 declared conformance beam direction pair 的 EIRP measurement 必須相對於 manufacturer declared rated beam EIRP value 維持在規定範圍內。

EIRP › 與 TRP 的關係
依來源：

- Far field 中 radiation intensity 定義為 I(θ,φ) = EIRP(θ,φ) / 4π。
- [[TRP]] 可由 EIRP over sphere 積分估算。
- 因此 EIRP 是方向性量測，[[TRP]] 是全空間 total radiated power metric。

R&S ELEKTRA › 使用限制
- [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]] 未提供 ELEKTRA software version、release date、formal datasheet、order numbers、license dependencies 或 supported standards matrix。
- Option list 是簡報表格，不可推論完整商業配置或價格。
- 來源未說明 ELEKTRA 與 [[EMC32]] 的版本差異、migration path 或 backward compatibility。
- `Control R&S and other instruments` 不代表任意 third-party instruments 均支援；需 driver list / release notes 補證。
- Wireless EMC / EMS slides 是 solution overview，未提供完整 test limits、uncertainty、accreditation scope 或 application note 文件號。

R&S ELEKTRA › Substitution method
依來源：

- RSE measurement including substitution 的 reference method 為 substitution。
- DUT replaced by a calibrated antenna with signal generator。
- Signal generator level tuned to same receive value as DUT。
- EIRP calculated by adding antenna gain and cable loss。
- Supported by ELEKTRA。

R&S ELEKTRA › unresolved
- 正式 datasheet、software version、licensing 與 supported standard list 未取得。
- [[ELEMI-EAS]]、[[ELEMI-RSE]]、[[ELEMI-3D]]、[[ELEMI-5GFC]]、[[ELEMI-OOB]] 等 options 的 order numbers、dependencies 與 release availability 未標示。
- 與 [[R&S ESW]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S TS8996]]、[[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 的配置角色仍需正式 system documentation 補證。
- Satellite / NTN RSE customization 的交付方式與限制未標示。
- [[ELEMS-ABT]] audio breakthrough application note 未擷取正文。

R&S ELEKTRA › SAC height-scan correction
依來源：

- FAR precalibrated measurement 中 antenna height、DUT height、test distance constant，因此 free space loss constant。
- SAC precalibrated measurement 中 DUT height and horizontal test distance constant，但 effective test distance depends on antenna height。
- ELEKTRA can correct this test distance variation automatically。

R&S ELEKTRA › Wireless EMC / EMS extension
[[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]] 另列出 wireless EMC / EMS 相關功能：

- Wireless EMC Extension: EMI tests for wireless devices；radiated and conducted emission test according ETSI EN 301 489；signaling also in EMI measurements supported。
- EMS tests for wireless devices：susceptibility tests according [[TS 134.124]] and ETSI EN 301 489。
- Signaling options include link quality measurement for wireless devices with data application，例如 BER、BLER、FER、PER。
- Radiated EMS tests for wireless devices with audio：susceptibility tests according TS 134.124 and ETSI EN 301 489；audio measurement for wireless devices with audio functionality。
- ELEKTRA option [[ELEMS-ABT]]；uses external audio analyzer or CMW internal audio analyzer；application note available with detailed setup description。

5G FR2 RSE 測試 › ELEKTRA workflow
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

1. Overview measurement：scan over complete sphere, wide frequency subrange, continuous azimuth / elevation, V / H polarisation。
2. Data reduction：detect critical frequencies，limit check，例如 FCC 20 dB below limit (-33 dBm/MHz) as early pass / fail criteria。
3. Maximization：high-resolution maximum EIRP search over complete sphere。
4. Adjustment：loop over azimuth, elevation, polarization H / V / +45° / -45°, x-y variation of test antenna。
5. Final measurement：2 orthogonal cuts, 3rd orthogonal cut, 2-cut / 3-cut TRP, if limit exceeded full TRP。

[[R&S ELEKTRA]] also supports virtual RMS detectors with 100 MHz and 200 MHz bandwidth, integrating lower-bandwidth measurements over a sliding window for ETSI -10 dBm/100 MHz limit.

5G FR2 RSE 測試 › ETSI / CE RED 口徑
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- ETSI 301 908-25 draft covers RSE for 5G FR2。
- 來源說該 draft in line with [[ERC Recommendation 74-01]]（1998, amended 29 May 2019）。
- Limits table：

| Frequency range | Maximum level (TRP) | Measurement bandwidth |
|---|---:|---:|
| 30 MHz to 1 GHz | -36 dBm | 100 kHz |
| 1 GHz to 7.25 GHz | -30 dBm | 1 MHz |
| 7.25 GHz to 2nd harmonic | -13 dBm | 1 MHz |
| 7.25 GHz to 2nd harmonic | -10 dBm | 100 MHz |

- Above 7.25 GHz both limits are simultaneously applicable。
- Smaller resolution bandwidth with integration over measurement bandwidth is allowed。
- OOB boundary from edge of channel bandwidth：50 MHz channel BW → 100 MHz；100 MHz → 200 MHz；200 MHz → 400 MHz；400 MHz → 800 MHz。
- 來源說 ETSI covers only devices with highest power class 3。
- 來源稱 ETSI requires start at 30 MHz and additional limit -10 dBm/100 MHz (-30 dBm/MHz) → [[R&S TS8996]]。

5G FR2 RSE 測試 › 3GPP / RAN4 口徑
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- 3GPP / RAN4 RSE specification: **9 kHz to 2nd harmonic**。
- RSE test requirement: **6 GHz to 2nd harmonic**。
- Limit: **-13 dBm**。
- Method: [[TRP]]。
- 在 TS8996 / TS8980 differentiation slide 中，來源稱 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]] with compact CATR [[R&S ATS1800C]] includes RSE **6 GHz to 92 GHz**, limit **-13 dBm/MHz** acc. 3GPP。

5G FR2 RSE 測試
[[5G FR2 RSE 測試]]是針對 5G FR2 devices 的 [[Radiated Spurious Emissions]] 測試主題；[[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]（07/2025）把它拆成 3GPP / FCC / ETSI requirements、TS8980 / TS8996 分工、FR2 signal conditioning、above-40-GHz extension 與 [[R&S ELEKTRA]] test workflow。

5G FR2 RSE 測試 › TS8980 與 TS8996 分工
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- 5G FR1：[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]] covers validated conducted 3GPP / ETSI tests；另需 radiated RSE（[[R&S TS8996]]）、EMC（[[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]]）與 OTA（[[R&S TS8991]]）。
- 5G FR2：all tests radiated。
- 3GPP validated tests with [[R&S ATS1800C]] → [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。
- ETSI / FCC broader RSE requirements → [[R&S TS8996]]。
- TS8996 被來源描述為 up to 220 GHz / 325 GHz in anechoic chamber。

TRP › TRP measurement grids
來源列出 TRP measurement grids：

- 2-cut grid。
- 3-cut grid。
- Equal angle grid。
- Equal area grid。
- Fibonacci grid。

來源說 TRP measurement grids 參考 [[3GPP TR 37.941]] subsection 6.3.4。

Radiated Spurious Emissions › 在 R&S solution mapping 中的位置
依 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]]：

- RSE 出現在 CE RED Art 3.2 radio spectrum 與 FCC wireless regulatory testing 語境。
- 來源將 [[R&S TS8996]] 列為 RSE solution mapping。
- 來源對 5G FR2 提到 RSE up to 200 GHz、high sensitivity -40 dBm/MHz、special signaling、conditioning for carrier 與 all standards support。
- RSE test can use spectrum analyzer or EMI receiver；RF analysis need spectrum analyzer，EMC test standards need EMI receiver。

依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- RSE has always to be evaluated, also for precertified modules。
- Basic RSE setup 類似 commercial EMI test。
- TS8996 supports 2G / 3G / 4G / 5G FR1 / WLAN / BT，並可擴充到 5G FR2 / above 40 GHz。
- 測試場地可為 FAR with azimuth / optional elevation scan，或 SAC with height scan。
- 常見 test distance 為 3 m；為提高 sensitivity 可使用 1 m。
- Signal conditioning 是 RSE 的關鍵，因為 high-power carrier 可能使 receiver / analyzer overload，特別是 near-carrier measurement。

Radiated Spurious Emissions › Substitution method
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- Reference method: substitution。
- DUT replaced by calibrated antenna with signal generator。
- Signal generator level tuned to same receive value as DUT。
- EIRP calculated by adding antenna gain and cable loss。
- [[R&S ELEKTRA]] supports this method。

FR2 OTA spatial test metrics › EIRP CDF metric
來源文字：

- EIRP CDF metric：3D EIRP scan with the same link & measurement antenna, CDF for power。
- 來源把 spherical coverage 連到 EIRP CDF metric。

判斷：本來源將 [[EIRP]] CDF 作為 TX scan / spherical coverage 類 metric；這補充 [[EIRP]] 既有頁的方向性 radiated power 定義，但不取代 GFM324 的 formal test context。

FR2 OTA spatial test metrics › EIS CDF / RX Beam Peak metric
來源文字：

- EIS CDF metric：CDF for reference sensitivity with a 3D Throughput scan。
- RX Beam peak metric：At best RX beam measure EIS for Ref Sens or interferer tests。
- For chapter 7 the beam peak is Rx beam peak = 0%-tile of EIS CDF = strongest beam。
- Source note：0%-tile is where the most sensitive link was found。

判斷：本來源以 [[EIS]] CDF 支撐 receiver sensitivity / throughput scan 語境，並將 0%-tile 定義為最敏感 link / strongest RX beam 的方向。

FR2 OTA spatial test metrics
[[FR2 OTA spatial test metrics]] 是 [[TS8980_RF_Conf_FR2_Customer_Presentation_Status_2020_11_02]]（2020-11-02）用來說明 [[5G FR2 RF conformance testing]] 的 OTA / spatial metric 集合，涵蓋 [[EIRP]] CDF、[[EIRP]] @ beam peak、[[TRP]] @ beam peak、[[EIS]] CDF 與 RX beam peak。

FR2 OTA spatial test metrics › 來源中的 metric overview
依 [[TS8980_RF_Conf_FR2_Customer_Presentation_Status_2020_11_02]] Slide 10：

| Test / context | Metric |
|---|---|
| Scan / Max Power | [[EIRP]] CDF |
| 6.2.1 Max Tx Power | [[TRP]] / [[EIRP]] @ TX-BP |
| 6.3.1 Min Tx Power | [[EIRP]] @ TX-BP |
| 6.3.2 Off Power | [[TRP]] @ TX-BP |
| 6.3.3 On/Off Time Mask | @ TX-BeamPeak |
| 6.4.1 Frequency Error | @ TX-BP |
| 6.4.2.1 Carrier Leakage | @ TX-BP |
| 6.4.2.2 EVM | @ TX-BP |
| 6.4.2.4 Spectral Flatness | @ TX-BP |
| 6.5.3.1 OBW | @ TX-BP |
| 6.5.2 SEM | [[TRP]] @ BP |
| 6.5.3.2.4 ACLR | [[TRP]] / [[EIRP]] @ BP |
| TX Spurious Emissions | [[TRP]] @ BP |
| Scan / Throughput Scan | [[EIS]] CDF |
| 7.3 Ref. Sensitivity, EIS | @ RX-BP |
| 7.4 Max Input Level | @ RX-BP |
| 7.5 ACS | @ RX-BP |
| 7.6.1 In-Band Blocking | @ RX-BP |
| 7.9 Rx Spurious Emissions | [[TRP]] @ RX-BP |

- 本頁只摘要 [[GFM324_1e_5G_NR_BaseStation_OTA_TX_Tests]]（06.2020），不是 [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]] 正式標準全文。
- 本來源採 Release 16 V16.3.0；既有 2023-06 簡報已引用 v17.5，正式測試需回查目標 release。

RSE Test System TS8996 (1)
這份 2025/07 company restricted 簡報介紹 [[R&S TS8996]] Radiated Spurious Emission（[[Radiated Spurious Emissions]]）test system，涵蓋 2G / 3G / 4G / [[5G NR]] FR1、WLAN、Bluetooth，以及 5G FR2 最高到 220 GHz / 325 GHz 的 RSE 測試擴充方案。

RSE Test System TS8996 (1) › 重點摘要
- 來源標題為 `Radited Spurious Emission (RSE) Test System TS8996`，頁尾日期標示 **07/2025**；`Radited` 為原文拼字。
- 基本 RSE setup 類似 commercial EMI test，可用 FAR 搭配 DUT azimuth 與 optional elevation scan，也可用 SAC 搭配 height scan。
- 基本頻率範圍列為 **30 MHz to 12.75 / 26 GHz / 40 GHz**，使用 spectrum analyzer 或 spectrum analyzer + test receiver；test distance 可為 **3 m**，或為提高 sensitivity 使用 **1 m**。
- 系統要求 high sensitivity、stable radiated radiocommunication link、signal conditioning，並由 [[R&S ELEKTRA]] 全自動控制。
- 來源明示 [[R&S TS8996]] 可作 turnkey solution，也可與 EMC test system 或 regulatory test system（[[R&S TS8997]]）組合 / 擴充。
- 3G / 4G / 5G FR1 的 signal conditioning 使用 [[OSP-B155G]]，頻率範圍 **30 MHz to 8 GHz**；支援 RED carrier up to **30 dBm**、FCC carrier up to **36 dBm**，並支援 5G NSA mode with 2 simultaneous carriers（LTE and 5G）。
- 1 GHz to 40 GHz 使用 [[TS-PRE2]] 與 [[TS-LNA1840]]；1–18 GHz 需 high sensitivity 與 carrier suppression，18–40 GHz 則把 receiver 放在 anechoic chamber 內並以 fiber optic 控制。
- 來源稱 typical sensitivity：TX at 3 m 可達 **-30 dBm with 12 dB S/N**（即 -42 dBm，peak detector）；RX at 1 m 可達 **-47 dBm with 12 dB S/N**（即 -59 dBm，peak detector）。
- [[R&S ELEKTRA]] 提供 RSE 專用功能：3D EIRP evaluation、ELEMI-OOB burst analysis、substitution method、SAC height-scan correction、CMW / CMX signaling、multi-band measurement。
- [[R&S ELEKTRA]] RSE option list 包含 ELEMI-EAS、ELEMI-RSE、ELEMI-3D、ELEMC-WRLS、ELEMC-CELS、ELEMC-5GS、ELEMI-5GFC、ELEMI-OOB、ELEMI-MBM、ELEMC-DRV。
- 5G FR2 section 指出 FCC / ANSI C63.26 的 RSE upper frequency 依 fundamental frequency 決定：RF signal <10 GHz 到 10th harmonic max 40 GHz；RF signal <30 GHz 到 5th harmonic max 100 GHz；RF signal >30 GHz 到 5th harmonic max 200 GHz。
- 3GPP / RAN4 對 5G FR2 的 RSE specification 為 **9 kHz to 2nd harmonic**，test requirement 為 **6 GHz to 2nd harmonic**，limit **-13 dBm**，method 為 [[TRP]]。

RSE Test System TS8996 (1) › 重點摘要
- FCC 47 CFR Part 30 / KDB 842590 / ANSI C63.26 對 5G FR2 的來源說法為 **30 MHz up to 5th harmonic / 100 GHz or 200 GHz**，limit **-13 dBm**，method 為 [[TRP]]，並提到 EIRP early exit criteria。
- ETSI 301 908-25 draft covers 5G FR2 RSE，依 ERC Recommendation 74-01（1998, amended 29 May 2019），並列出 30 MHz to 1 GHz、1 GHz to 7.25 GHz、7.25 GHz to 2nd harmonic 的 TRP limits。
- 來源把 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]] 做區分：FR1 中 TS8980 負責 validated conducted tests，另需 radiated RSE（TS8996）、EMC（TS9982）、OTA（TS8991）；FR2 中 3GPP validated tests with ATS1800C 屬 TS8980，而 ETSI / FCC 額外 RSE 需求屬 TS8996。
- 來源稱 TS8980 with compact CATR ATS1800C includes RSE 6 GHz to 92 GHz, limit -13 dBm/MHz acc. 3GPP；而 [[R&S TS8996]] up to **220 GHz / 325 GHz** in anechoic chamber。
- 5G FR2 signal conditioning 18–50 GHz 使用 [[TS-PRE1850]]，18–40 GHz base，40–50 GHz extension with antenna [[TS-PRE-B1]]，可同時測 spurious 與 carrier。
- 41–325 GHz system extension 包含 receive units [[TC-RSE60]]、[[TC-RSE90]]、[[TC-RSE140]]、[[TC-RSE220]]、[[TC-RSE325]] 與 multiplier units [[TC-MX60]]、[[TC-MX90]]、[[TC-MX140]]、[[TC-MX220]]、[[TC-MX325]]，並以 [[OSP220]]、[[R&S ESW44]] with B21、[[R&S SMB100A]]、[[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S ELEKTRA]] 組成系統。
- TC-RSE units 的 sensitivity EIRP 來源標示為 **< -40 dBm/MHz**（RMS detector）at **1 m** test distance。
- 5G FR2 ELEKTRA procedure 包含 overview measurement、data reduction、maximization、adjustment、final measurement，並支援 virtual RMS detector with 100 MHz / 200 MHz bandwidth。

FCC 無線設備法規測試 › 5G FR2 RSE requirement 口徑
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]（07/2025）：

- ANSI C63.26 RSE Frequency Ranges USA：
  - RF signal <10 GHz: 10th harmonic, max. 40 GHz。
  - RF signal <30 GHz: 5th harmonic, max. 100 GHz。
  - RF signal >30 GHz: 5th harmonic, max. 200 GHz。
- FCC 47 CFR Part 30, KDB 842590 and ANSI C63.26：
  - 30 MHz up to 5th harmonic / 100 GHz（devices <30 GHz）, 200 GHz（devices >30 GHz）。
  - Limit -13 dBm。
  - Method: [[TRP]]。
  - Early exit criteria for [[EIRP]], TRP only for failing frequencies。
  - Test distance 公式在轉檔中顯示為 `≥ 2D2/`，不完整，需回查原投影片或 FCC / ANSI 原文。
- 同來源在 TS8996 / TS8980 differentiation 中說 FCC requires 30 MHz to 5th harmonic / 200 GHz and semi anechoic chamber → [[R&S TS8996]]。

⚠️ [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]（07/2025）說 FCC 5G FR2 RSE requirement starts at 30 MHz up to 5th harmonic / 100 GHz or 200 GHz，但既有頁面 [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]] 說 5G NR FR2 FCC analyzer frequency range 是 9 kHz–200 GHz。判斷：兩者可能分別是 test requirement lower bound 與 analyzer / general spectrum investigation range 口徑；未回查 47 CFR、KDB 842590 與 ANSI C63.26 前並列保留。

EIRP › 來源定義
依 [[GFM324_1e_5G_NR_BaseStation_OTA_TX_Tests]]（06.2020）：

- EIRP 表示特定方向的 absolute output power。
- 若未定義方向，EIRP 隱含為 maximum radiation intensity 的方向。
- EIRP 是 ideal isotropic radiator 為達到同一方向相同 power density 所需的 input power。
- EIRP 等於 antenna accepted power 乘以 antenna gain，或 radiated power 乘以 directivity。
- 來源公式：EIRP = Pin × G。
- 來源公式：EIRP dBm = Pin,dBm + GdBi。

Time Domain Channel Properties
[[Time Domain Channel Properties]]（TDCP）是 [[Release 18]] 中用於描述 channel time-domain behavior、[[UE]] relative mobility 與 associated Doppler 的新 measurement / CSI-related quantity，可協助 [[gNB]] 在 high-speed scenarios 中調整 transmission configuration。[[R18 CSI enhancements for high-speed Scenario]] [[TDCP Reporting]]

3GPP TS 38.215 › unresolved
- 需補 [[3GPP TS 38.215]] 的正式題名、發布組織、version、release 與發布日期。
- 需確認 TDCP definition 的 exact clause 與 wording。
- 需確認 [[TDCP report]] 是否在 38.215 僅定義 measurement，或也牽涉 report interpretation。

R&S CONTEST › Test system selection and operation
依 [[RS_TS8980FTA_PRE_Series_SystemManual_en_63]]：

- 在 [[R&S CONTEST]] > Test System > Select Test System 選擇 test system。
- 可依不同 system components 設定 filters，只列出 subset of suitable configurations。
- Filter categories 包含 Test Category、R&S CONTEST Host、Combiners、CMW Setup、CMX Setup 與 Anechoic Chambers。
- Test Category 可選 RF、RRM 等 test case category。
- R&S CONTEST Host 可選 software installed location，例如 System Controller。
- CMW Setup 可描述 [[R&S CMW500]] environment，例如 [[R&S CMWflexx]]。
- CMX Setup 可描述 [[R&S CMX500]] environment，例如 Single CMX500。
- Anechoic Chambers filter 可選 chamber，例如 [[R&S ATS1800C]]。
- 若 test system 未列出，可將 Include Experimental Test Systems 設為 ON 顯示更多 supported test systems。
- 若知道 test system name 或部分名稱，可使用 full text search。
- 最後需在 Hardware Configuration table 中選擇並 enable devices。

R&S ZNB3020 › Measurement accuracy 摘錄
資料有效條件：+18 °C to +28 °C；calibration 後溫度變化不超過 1 °C；使用 R&S®ZN-Z235（with 3.5 mm test port adapter connector）或 R&S®ZN-Z229 calibration kit 時資料有效性為 conditional；measurement 與 calibration 的 frequency points、measurement bandwidth、sweep time 必須相同；不允許 interpolation。

Transmission uncertainty 條件：matched DUT、measurement bandwidth 10 Hz、nominal source power –10 dBm、enhanced dynamic range mode on。

| 9 kHz to 300 kHz | 0 dB to –20 dB | 0.05 dB、0.3° |
| >300 kHz to 1 MHz | 0 dB to –20 dB | 0.04 dB、0.3° |
| >1 MHz to 4 GHz | 0 dB to –20 dB | 0.04 dB、0.3° |
| >1 MHz to 4 GHz | –50 dB to –60 dB | 0.10 dB、0.7° |
| >4 GHz to 9 GHz | 0 dB to –20 dB | 0.05 dB、0.4° |
| >9 GHz to 26.5 GHz | 0 dB to –20 dB | 0.06 dB、0.7° |
| >9 GHz to 26.5 GHz | –50 dB to –60 dB | 0.12 dB、1.0° |

衛星酬載群延遲量測
[[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]是用來判定 satellite communications transmission path phase distortions、frequency converter / transponder channel band edge distortion 與 transmission path quality 的測試方法集合。

R&S SMW200A › Floating license rules
- 某些 software options 可在 two-path instruments 中安裝一次或兩次。
- 多數 path-specific software options 採 floating license concept。
- 若 option features 要同時在兩個 paths 使用，該 option 必須安裝兩次。
- 若 option 只安裝一次，只能在 path A 或 path B 其中之一使用。
- Software option 不綁定特定 path。
- 對 baseband generator 也是類似規則：若兩個 baseband generators 要同時輸出相同 standard 或 waveform，對應 software option 必須安裝兩次。

Reverberation chamber OTA testing › 與 anechoic chamber 的差異
來源只提供高層次差異：anechoic test chambers 與 reverberation chambers 不同；reverberation chambers 透過 RF signal 反射形成 Rayleigh faded multipath RF environment。來源未提供 anechoic chamber 的詳細定義、吸波材料規格、direct path isolation、test correlation 或標準化測試方法比較。

Knowledge 類資料 › 必須保留的不確定性
[[Knowledge README]] 明確說明：原文沒寫的東西，ingest 應寫「來源未標示」並記進 unresolved，不應自行補齊。這對 [[標準版本與發布組織]] 特別重要：

- 標準原文有寫版本與組織時，應精確記錄。
- 原文未標示版本或組織時，應明寫「來源未標示」。
- 不得從檔名、上下文或常識推理補上版本、發布組織、日期或代碼。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

Time Domain Channel Properties › Spec change 線索
[[TDCP Reporting]] 列出：

- [[3GPP TS 38.215]]：TDCP definition。
- [[3GPP TS 38.214]]：TDCP reporting changes；來源說 this spec best describes how this feature works。
- [[3GPP TS 38.211]]：No changes relevant to Rel-18 TDCP CSI reporting。
- [[3GPP TS 38.212]]：TDCP reporting parameter changes。
- [[3GPP TS 38.306]]：UE Capabilities changes。
- [[3GPP 38.822]]：TDCP-related capabilities。

來源沒有列出 spec version、CR number 或 clause，因此這些只作為待回查索引。

3GPP TS 38.215 › 使用限制
- 本頁不是 [[3GPP TS 38.215]] 的正式摘要。
- 不可從 [[TDCP Reporting]] 的單行 spec-change list 推論 38.215 的完整標題、scope 或 clause。
- 需回正式 3GPP 文件確認 [[Time Domain Channel Properties]] 的 definition、measurement quantity、unit、range、reporting relationship 與 release version。

R&S CONTEST › Test case information and validation files
依 [[RS_TS8980FTA_PRE_Series_SystemManual_en_63]] glossary：

- `TC`：Test Case，常用於 conformance test applications 命名。
- `TCI`：Test Case Information；相關 `.rsetci` file 包含 test case information，供 [[R&S CONTEST]] read-in。
- `TCV`：Test Case Validation；相關 `.rsetcv` file 包含 [[GCF]] 與 [[PTCRB]] 的 current validation status，由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 定期更新並由 [[R&S CONTEST]] read-in，透過 [[Installation Manager]] 安裝。
- `TTCN`：Tree and Tabular Combined Notation（TTCN-2）與 Testing and Test Control Notation（TTCN-3）。

### Short answer
Measurement method is the specific way a test quantity is measured and evaluated, such as RSE by TRP, EIRP coarse-grid screening followed by TRP fine-grid measurement, or the substitution reference method where the DUT is replaced by a calibrated antenna and signal generator and EIRP is calculated from antenna gain and cable loss [5][6][29].  
Product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding the method include whether to configure for EIRP or TRP evaluation, whether to use early-exit EIRP screening before TRP, which grid/procedure to use, which chamber/scan geometry to support, which detector bandwidth/integration approach to use, and which R&S system/software/options fit the required workflow [1][3][5][6][8][33].  
### Measurement method examples supported by the passages
- For FCC / ANSI C63.26 5G FR2 RSE, the stated method is TRP, with EIRP early-exit criteria and TRP only for failing frequencies [6].  
- For RSE measurement including substitution, the reference method is substitution: the DUT is replaced by a calibrated antenna with signal generator, the generator level is tuned to the same receive value as the DUT, and EIRP is calculated by adding antenna gain and cable loss [29].  
- TRP procedure selection depends on available test setup, measurement equipment, and measurement time [8].  
### Product-related decisions that depend on it
| Decision | Why measurement method matters | Supported product / option facts |
|---|---|---|
| Choose EIRP vs TRP evaluation | R&S ELEKTRA supports 3D EIRP evaluation by measuring EIRP instead of field strength, while 5G FR2 RSE requirements are often expressed with TRP and may use EIRP as a screening step before TRP [1][11]. | ELEKTRA option ELEMI-3D supports 3D EIRP evaluation, SAC/FAR 3D measurement, elevation positioner, spherical elevation or cylindrical height scan, and 3D result presentation [1]. |
| Decide whether early-exit screening is acceptable | FCC / ANSI C63.26 is described as using EIRP early-exit criteria, with TRP only for failing frequencies [6]. | ELEKTRA’s 5G FR2 workflow includes overview measurement, data reduction, maximization, adjustment, and final measurement [33]. |
| Select grid density and TRP procedure | The two-step RSE method uses coarse and fine grids, and the listed grid points differ by coarse/fine and constant-density/constant-step-size approaches [5]. | ELEKTRA’s final measurement can calculate 2-cut TRP and 3-cut TRP, and full TRP is performed if the limit is exceeded [33]. |
| Select chamber and scan geometry | R&S ELEKTRA supports SAC and FAR 3D measurement, elevation positioner, spherical elevation scan, and cylindrical height scan [1]. | TS8996 basic RSE setup can use FAR with azimuth and optional elevation scan, or SAC with height scan [39]. |
| Choose detector bandwidth / integration | ELEKTRA supports virtual RMS detectors with 100 MHz and 200 MHz bandwidth by integrating lower-bandwidth measurements over a sliding window [3]. | This is used for parallel measurement of -13 dBm/MHz and -10 dBm/100 MHz limits [3]. |
| Choose R&S system scope for FR2 RSE | For FR2, 3GPP validated tests with ATS1800C are mapped to TS8980, while ETSI / FCC broader RSE requirements are mapped to TS8996 [37]. | TS8996 is described as supporting 5G FR2 RSE extensions up to 220 GHz / 325 GHz in an anechoic chamber [37]. |
| Decide whether substitution capability is needed | RSE reference method is substitution, and ELEKTRA supports it [29]. | In the substitution method, the DUT is replaced by a calibrated antenna with signal generator and EIRP is calculated from antenna gain and cable loss [29]. |

R&S ELEKTRA › 3D EIRP Evaluation / ELEMI-3D
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

R&S ELEKTRA › 5G FR2 test procedure support
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- ELEKTRA is next generation EMC test SW。
- For 5G support of RSE measurement procedures with extension for 5G FR2。
- 支援 3D and TRP evaluation。
- 支援 5G signaling with [[R&S CMX500]]。
- Mixers and calibration procedure also supported by EMC32。
- EMI test sequence adopted to support RSE requirements。
- Sweeps 可 free run（for FDD）或 gated sweep（triggered by CMX, for TDD）。
- 支援 elevation positioner。
- 支援 3D view possibility for overview measurement, maximization and final TRP measurement。
- Typical test distance: **1 m for >40 GHz** and **3 m for <40 GHz**。
- Workflow steps 包含 overview measurement、data reduction、maximization、adjustment、final measurement。
- Virtual RMS detectors with **100 MHz and 200 MHz bandwidth** 可把 lower bandwidth measurement integration over 100 MHz / 200 MHz sliding window，用於平行量測 -13 dBm/MHz 與 -10 dBm/100 MHz limits。

5G FR2 RSE 測試 › EIRP / TRP two-step method
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- 先用 [[EIRP]] coarse grid identify spurious emission frequencies。
- EIRP limit is valid as long as max. EIRP is below TRP limit。
- 對 EIRP above the limit 的 frequencies，用 fine grid 執行 [[TRP]]。
- Grid selection for spurious emissions is up to test system implementation，但需 meet criteria。
- 來源列出的 grid points：coarse constant density 35；coarse constant step size 62（30°）；fine constant density 135；fine constant step size 266（15°）。

5G FR2 RSE 測試 › FCC / ANSI C63.26 口徑
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- ANSI C63.26 RSE frequency ranges：
  - RF signal <10 GHz: 10th harmonic, max. 40 GHz。
  - RF signal <30 GHz: 5th harmonic, max. 100 GHz。
  - RF signal >30 GHz: 5th harmonic, max. 200 GHz。
- FCC 47 CFR Part 30, KDB 842590 and ANSI C63.26：
  - 30 MHz up to 5th harmonic / 100 GHz（devices <30 GHz）或 200 GHz（devices >30 GHz）。
  - Limit -13 dBm。
  - Method: TRP。
  - Early exit criteria for EIRP, TRP only for failing frequencies。
  - Test distance formula 在來源中 OCR 為 `≥ 2D2/`，公式不完整，需回查原文。
- 來源稱 FCC requires 30 MHz to 5th harmonic / 200 GHz and semi anechoic chamber → [[R&S TS8996]]。

⚠️ [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]（07/2025）說 FCC 5G FR2 RSE requirement starts at 30 MHz up to 5th harmonic / 100 GHz or 200 GHz，但既有頁面 [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]] 說 5G NR FR2 FCC analyzer frequency range 是 9 kHz–200 GHz。判斷：兩者可能分別是 test requirement lower bound 與 analyzer / general spectrum investigation range 口徑；未回查 47 CFR、KDB 842590 與 ANSI C63.26 前並列保留。

TRP › TRP measurement procedures
來源列出多種 TRP procedures：

1. Full sphere using reference steps（accurate）。
2. Full sphere using sparse sampling（overestimate）。
3. Two cuts + Pattern multiplication（accurate）；Pattern multiplication 是 conditional。
4. Two/three cuts（overestimate）。
5. Beam-based directions。
6. Peak method。
7. Equal sector with peak average。
8. Pre-scan。

來源指出 procedure 選擇取決於 available test setup、measurement equipment 與 measurement time。

Radiated Spurious Emissions › RSE 與 EIRP / TRP
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- [[R&S ELEKTRA]] 支援 3D [[EIRP]] evaluation：量測 Effective Isotropic Radiated Power instead of field strength。
- 5G FR2 來源多以 [[TRP]] method 表示 test requirement。
- ETSI 301 908-25 draft 來源描述 two-step method：先用 EIRP coarse grid 找 spurious frequencies，再對 EIRP above limit 的 frequencies 執行 TRP fine grid。
- Final measurement 可計算 2-cut TRP、3-cut TRP；若 limit exceeded，另執行 full TRP。

R&S ELEKTRA › Substitution method
依來源：

- RSE measurement including substitution 的 reference method 為 substitution。
- DUT replaced by a calibrated antenna with signal generator。
- Signal generator level tuned to same receive value as DUT。
- EIRP calculated by adding antenna gain and cable loss。
- Supported by ELEKTRA。

5G FR2 RSE 測試 › ELEKTRA workflow
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

1. Overview measurement：scan over complete sphere, wide frequency subrange, continuous azimuth / elevation, V / H polarisation。
2. Data reduction：detect critical frequencies，limit check，例如 FCC 20 dB below limit (-33 dBm/MHz) as early pass / fail criteria。
3. Maximization：high-resolution maximum EIRP search over complete sphere。
4. Adjustment：loop over azimuth, elevation, polarization H / V / +45° / -45°, x-y variation of test antenna。
5. Final measurement：2 orthogonal cuts, 3rd orthogonal cut, 2-cut / 3-cut TRP, if limit exceeded full TRP。

[[R&S ELEKTRA]] also supports virtual RMS detectors with 100 MHz and 200 MHz bandwidth, integrating lower-bandwidth measurements over a sliding window for ETSI -10 dBm/100 MHz limit.

5G FR2 RSE 測試 › TS8980 與 TS8996 分工
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- 5G FR1：[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]] covers validated conducted 3GPP / ETSI tests；另需 radiated RSE（[[R&S TS8996]]）、EMC（[[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]]）與 OTA（[[R&S TS8991]]）。
- 5G FR2：all tests radiated。
- 3GPP validated tests with [[R&S ATS1800C]] → [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。
- ETSI / FCC broader RSE requirements → [[R&S TS8996]]。
- TS8996 被來源描述為 up to 220 GHz / 325 GHz in anechoic chamber。

Radiated Spurious Emissions › 在 R&S solution mapping 中的位置
依 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]]：

- RSE 出現在 CE RED Art 3.2 radio spectrum 與 FCC wireless regulatory testing 語境。
- 來源將 [[R&S TS8996]] 列為 RSE solution mapping。
- 來源對 5G FR2 提到 RSE up to 200 GHz、high sensitivity -40 dBm/MHz、special signaling、conditioning for carrier 與 all standards support。
- RSE test can use spectrum analyzer or EMI receiver；RF analysis need spectrum analyzer，EMC test standards need EMI receiver。

依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- RSE has always to be evaluated, also for precertified modules。
- Basic RSE setup 類似 commercial EMI test。
- TS8996 supports 2G / 3G / 4G / 5G FR1 / WLAN / BT，並可擴充到 5G FR2 / above 40 GHz。
- 測試場地可為 FAR with azimuth / optional elevation scan，或 SAC with height scan。
- 常見 test distance 為 3 m；為提高 sensitivity 可使用 1 m。
- Signal conditioning 是 RSE 的關鍵，因為 high-power carrier 可能使 receiver / analyzer overload，特別是 near-carrier measurement。
